_comment: Connection-manifest for the Graphics department. verify-wiring.sh reads this file and checks each required cfg_key. Advisory (required:false) entries are documentation-only hooks verify-wiring.sh reports but never gates on.

connection_points.name: gip-prompt-authoring-route
connection_points.description: Per decision GK-D2 (Presentation-mirror, Option A phased): every AI-image-generation prompt in this department is authored by the dedicated Prompt Author role (prompt-author-graphics.md) from the requesting role's creative brief, then independently graded by the Prompt QC Specialist (qc-specialist-prompt-graphics.md, judge != writer) BEFORE the Generation Operator's SOP-DIU-601 preflight ever sees it. No producing role self-authors or self-certifies its own final prompt text. Advisory (required:false) — this is a documentation hook, not a live cfg_key; wiring is enforced structurally (both role files must exist in this department + be registered in _index.json) and mechanically (diu_validator.py prompt-band + the Prompt-QC report), not via openclaw.json.

connection_points.name: kie-api-key
connection_points.description: Kie.ai API key for AI image generation used by graphics production roles. The client's own key; the accepted alias family is defined once in shared-utils/secret_names.json (see alias_source), never restated here. Ownership: the Generation Operator is the sole createTask caller and receipt creator (Skill 74: validate, preflight at price x 1.30, prompt-budget, submit --mode active); the Render Dispatcher polls, runs postflight, and recovers orphans. Lifecycle, rate limits, and credit rules: 07-kie-setup/references/kie-common-rules.md.

connection_points.name: ghl-api-key
connection_points.description: GoHighLevel API key for uploading finished graphics assets to the GHL media library.

connection_points.name: ghl-location-id
connection_points.description: GHL location ID for targeting the correct media library sub-account.

connection_points.name: gip-prompt-band-enforcement
connection_points.description: Prompt length for every KIE GPT Image and other KIE image prompt follows KIE prompt rule 12 (owner order 2026-10-05): 95 to 100 percent of the model's maxLength, hard floor 80 percent, hard ceiling 100 percent. No character numbers live here: the shared enforcer shared-utils/kie_prompt_enforcer.py reads them from Skill 74 prompt-budget (live schema, registry fallback). Enforced by diu_validator.py prompt-band (GIP) and prove_agnes_image_prompt_floor.py (Agnes). Logo prompts MUST use image-to-image (never text-to-image). Style-reference-only directive is MANDATORY whenever reference images are attached. Advisory (required:false) - enforced structurally via the Prompt Author -> Prompt QC Specialist -> Generation Operator SOP-DIU-601 chain + the deterministic gate scripts, not via openclaw.json.
